t: Iran, Oman Agree on Safe Passage Routes Through Strait of Hormuz - Reports
d: Iran and Oman have agreed on safe passage routes through the Strait of Hormuz and will report this information to an international body, Press TV reported on Thursday, citing Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei.

t: White House Directs Pentagon to Prepare Options for Strikes on Iran – Reports
d: The White House has directed the US Department of War to prepare options for strikes on Iran ahead of the midterm congressional elections, The Atlantic reported on Wednesday, citing two administration officials.

t: Riyadh Launches 82 Strikes Against Houthis Following Attacks on Its Airports - Coalition
d: The Saudi-led coalition against Yemen's Ansar Allah movement, also known as the Houthis, said it had launched 82 strikes on Houthi positions in response to attacks on airports in Abha and Riyadh.

t: Kim Jong-un's Sister Rejects South Korean Medical Equipment Offer as Provocation - State Media
d: Kim Yo-jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and a department director at the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party, on Thursday called South Korea's offer of medical equipment to North Korea a provocation and an insult.

t: Russia Monitoring EU's Militaristic Activities to Prepare Appropriate Response
d: Russia is monitoring the EU's militaristic activities in order to prepare appropriate response measures, Vladislav Maslennikov, the chief of the Department of European Issues at the Russian Foreign Ministry, told Sputnik.

t: Russian Forces Wipe Out Colombian Mercenaries’ Base in Ukraine
d: The large temporary deployment site in Dergachi, near Kharkov, housed fighters from the 23rd Special Purpose Regiment of Ukraine’s National Guard who had been transferred there from Kiev, according to Russia’s security services.

t: Ukrainian Conflict Requires Comprehensive Solution - Kremlin
d: The Ukrainian conflict requires a comprehensive solution, fragmented agreements will not lead to peace, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Thursday.

t: Rostec’s Nerekhta-E Robot Makes Global Debut - Built to Fight, Spy and Save Lives
d: The Nerekhta-E is a robot of many talents. Its modular design lets it serve as a scout, a gun platform against ground and aerial threats, or a medevac vehicle for wounded troops.

t: Russian Forces Liberate Annopolye Settlement in Kharkov Region
d: The Russian armed forces have liberated the settlement of Annopolye in the Kharkov region, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Thursday.

t: Russia Views Potential US Deployment of Troops to Baltic States as Escalation
d: Russia considers potential deployment of additional NATO contingents as escalation, including the US troops in Baltic states, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said on Thursday.

t: Russia’s Strikes Choke Ukraine’s War Machine of Power & Logistics, Fuel New Regions' Liberation
d: Russia’s strikes on Ukraine's power grid serve a dual purpose, military expert Alexander Mikhailov, head of the Bureau of Political Analysis, told Sputnik.

t: Putin Arrives in Turkmenistan on Working Visit
d: The Russian leader plans to take part in the meetings of the CIS Council of Heads of State and the Caspian Environmental Summit, as well as hold bilateral meetings with the presidents of Turkmenistan and Iran.

t: Crew Dragon Spacecraft With Russia's Fedyaev Onboard Returns to Earth
d: SpaceX’s Crew Dragon spacecraft with NASA’s Crew-12 mission that includes Russian cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev returned to Earth on Thursday, according to a NASA broadcast.

t: Iraq Reopens Air Bridge to Iran After US Sanctions Waiver
d: An Iraqi Airways jet has touched down at Tehran’s Imam Khomeini International Airport - the first international arrival since the US-Israeli 40-day war.

t: Russia Strikes Ship Delivering Cargo for Ukrainian Forces to Chernomorsk Port – Military
d: The Russian armed forces struck a cargo ship delivering supplies to the port of Chernomorsk for the Ukrainian armed forces, the Russian Ministry of Defense said on Thursday.

t: Putin Holds Bilateral Meeting With Turkmen President
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin held a bilateral meeting with Turkmeninstan President Serdar Berdimuhamedov, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Thursday.

t: Putin Holds Meetings During His Visit to Turkmenistan
d: The Russian leader is holding talks with his Turkmen counterpart Serdar Berdimuhamedov and, together with the heads of CIS member states, is visiting a festival of national dishes of the Commonwealth countries.

t: Putin Holds Meeting With Iranian President Pezeshkian in Turkmenistan
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin held a separate meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian during his visit to Turkmenistan, a Sputnik correspondent reported on Thursday.
